target.title: fix(model-fallback): re-throw LiveSessionModelSwitchError for outer retry loop (#101676)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a user changes the model mid-turn (via `/model`, session_status override, or cron job) while the AI is actively generating a response, the run terminates with an error instead of retrying the turn against the newly-selected model.

**Observed before fix (#101676):**
```
info: live session model switch requested: claude-sonnet-5 -> claude-sonnet-4-6
warn: model_fallback_decision decision=candidate_failed ... fallbackConfigured=false
error: Embedded agent failed before reply: Live session model switch requested
```

## Why This Change Was Made

The `runWithModelFallback` loop catches `LiveSessionModelSwitchError` from the embedded runner. When the switch target is not a later fallback candidate, it was wrapping the error as `FailoverError`. With no fallbacks configured, this reached `throwFallbackFailureSummary` producing `FallbackSummaryError` — not `LiveSessionModelSwitchError` — so the outer retry loop never caught it.

**Fix:** A new helper `isLiveSessionModelSwitchTargetInCandidates` distinguishes between three scenarios:

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| Target IS a later fallback candidate | Redirect there (unchanged, preserves #57471) |
| Target IS in candidates but stale (same/earlier) | Failover → continue fallback (preserves #58496) |
| Target NOT in candidates at all (genuine user switch) | **Rethrow → outer loop retries (#101676 fix)** |

The helper also accounts for auth-profile changes: credential-only switches (same model, different `authProfileId`) are treated as not-in-candidates so the outer retry loop can apply the new auth profile via `applyLiveModelSwitchToRun`.

The outer loop has bounded retries (`MAX_LIVE_SWITCH_RETRIES = 5` subagents, `2` main agent).

## Evidence

### Real Runtime Behavior — Live Mid-Turn Model Switch

A mid-turn model switch from `anthropic/claude-haiku-3-5` to `openrouter/free` was exercised on this PR head. The embedded runner detects the pending switch, `runWithModelFallback` re-throws it (target `openrouter/free` is not in the `[anthropic/claude-haiku-3-5]` candidate list), and the outer retry loop catches it and retries with the switched model:

```
[agent/embedded] embedded run agent end: isError=true
[agent/embedded] live session model switch requested during active attempt:
                 anthropic/claude-haiku-3-5 -> openrouter/openrouter/free
[agents/agent-command] Live session model switch in subagent run:
                       switching to openrouter/openrouter/free
[model-fetch] start provider=openrouter model=openrouter/free
[model-fetch] response status=200
```

The turn completes successfully with the user-requested model. Before the fix, `LiveSessionModelSwitchError` was wrapped as `FailoverError` → the outer loop never saw it → the turn failed with "Agent failed before reply: Live session model switch requested."

### Focused Tests — Seven Control-Flow Branches

```
 ✓ re-throws when the switch target is not a configured candidate (#101676)
 ✓ re-throws when target is not a later fallback candidate (#101676)
 ✓ re-throws on last candidate when switch target not in candidates (#101676)
 ✓ retries with the switched model after re-throw (#101676 end-to-end)
 ✓ re-throws for auth-profile-only switch (same model, different credentials) (#101676)
 ✓ jumps to a later live-session model switch candidate (#57471)
 ✓ keeps stale same-candidate switch errors in fallback rotation (#58496)
```

### Full Test Suite

```

live-model-switch.test.ts:            21 passed
agent-command.live-model-switch.test.ts: 76 passed
Total: 215 passed
```

